<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex009032025-11-2817-13-21" status="finalized"><milestone unit="section" n="23 bsgyur lugs"/>
         sgyur‹.›lugs la 
         <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">ar rgya</foreign> na' <lb n="7a4"/> 'phags pa'o ||
         <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">sa rba</foreign> na <abbr>thams cad</abbr> do ||
         <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">a ti</foreign> na yod par ro ||
         <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">bada'</foreign> na smra ba'o ||
         <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">shra ma ni ra</foreign> na dge' tshul lo ||
         <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">ka ri ka</foreign> na tshig le'ur byas pa'o ||
         <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">'bri ti</foreign> na 'grel pa'o ||
         <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">phra ba pa ti</foreign> na 'od ldan no || <note type="editorial">This indicates the Āryamūlasarvāstivādiśrāmaṇerakārikāvṛttiprabhāvatī (ID:3766) </note></seg></TEI>
